Title: How to Delete Screenshots and Videos on Nintendo Switch
IntroLines: Are screenshots and videos taking up too much storage space on your Nintendo Switch?
In this video, I'll show you how to delete individual captures, multiple files, or wipe them all at once.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: DELETE INDIVIDUAL SCREENSHOTS OR VIDEOS FROM THE ALBUM
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open the " Album " app from the bottom toolbar.
•  Then, browse through your media and press " A " on the screenshot or video you want to delete.
•  Now, press the " X " button on your controller to open the delete prompt.
•  Select " Delete " on the screen to confirm.
•  Finally, return to your Album and verify that the capture has been removed.
Sections.Bridge: If you want to clear out several captures at once without doing them one by one, let's select multiple items.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: SELECT AND DELETE MULTIPLE SCREENSHOTS AND VIDEOS
Steps: •  First, open the " Album " app from your HOME Menu.
•  Then, press the " Y " button on your controller if you want to filter by " Only Screenshots " or " Only Videos " .
•  From the Album grid view, press the " X " button on your controller.
•  Choose " Delete Multiple Items " from the menu.
•  Now, scroll through and press " A " to check the box next to every screenshot or video you want to remove.
•  After selecting your files, select " Delete Selected Items " on the right side of the screen.
•  Select " Delete " to confirm the deletion.
•  Finally, review your Album gallery to verify that all selected captures have been cleared.
Sections.Bridge: If you have hundreds of captures and want to wipe all of them at once, let's delete them through System Settings.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 3: DELETE ALL SCREENSHOTS AND VIDEOS AT ONCE VIA SYSTEM SETTINGS
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open " System Settings " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Data Management " .
•  On the right side, scroll down and select " Manage Screenshots and Videos " .
•  Select your storage location, choosing either " System Memory " or " microSD Card " .
•  Scroll down to the bottom and select " Delete All Screenshots and Videos " .
•  Select " Delete " to confirm the permanent removal of all captures.
•  Finally, check your Data Management screen to verify that your capture storage has been completely freed up.

OutroLines: And that's how you can easily delete screenshots and videos on your Nintendo Switch.
